stemBlocks: A sound wave is travelling from left to right in air. The diagram represents the wave at a particular instant, and a distance of $33 \text{ cm}$ is labelled. The speed of sound in air is $330 \text{ ms}^{-1}$.
What is the frequency of the sound and in which direction has the air at P been displaced from its mean position?

|  | frequency of sound / Hz | displacement of air at P |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | 1000 | to the left |
| B | 2500 | to the left |
| C | 5000 | to the left |
| D | 1000 | to the right |
| E | 2500 | to the right |
| F | 5000 | to the right |
